add.text: Page has 150 methods in one bag

add.title: The problem
add.text: Page 97, Item 30, Events 5. About 50 of Page's only pass a call on to a helper. Voice sees 9 (the help hides the rest); anyone reading the code sees all 150.

add.title: On /live/, tabs and columns don't draw
add.text: LivePage draws its own screen and skips the frame that draws tabs, columns and nav. A widget that draws itself would work on any page.
Idea 1: UI lives in modules, imported on need

add.title: What changes
add.text: Sidebar, header, nav, tabs, columns and previews each become one file. A page imports only the ones it uses. Page itself keeps data, url and children.

add.title: In code
add.text: `import "/framework/core/Page/ui/Tabs.js";` in the page's class file. Nothing loads that no page asked for.

add.title: Good / cost
add.text: Smallest Page. But code still needs a way to reach the widget, and where its state is saved is left open.

add.title: What changes
add.text: `page.ui.tabs` is made the first time it is touched, already wired to the page. Page gains one name instead of fifty.

add.title: From voice
add.text: `{"ui": {"tabs": {"selected": "Idea 2"}}}`. That line is saved in the page's log, so a reload shows the same tab.

add.title: Good / cost
add.text: State is saved for free, and the help shows `ui` once. Alone, though, every widget would be loaded on every page.

add.title: How they fit
add.text: Modules are where the code lives (idea 1). `page.ui` is how a page reaches them and saves their state (idea 2). A widget loads when the page's class imports it; `page.ui` only offers what loaded.

add.title: Try it
add.text: The tab bar above is the prototype: `page.ui.tabs`. Say "switch to Idea 1" and voice sends one line; reload and it stays.

add.title: If yes, next
add.text: Move tabs, columns and previews off Page into `core/Page/ui/`, one widget at a time, old names kept as shortcuts. About $15–25.
